Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies thisorder exists between,
Mr. A. W. K. Perera, No. 143/3, Horana Road, Mahawila, Panadura of the one part
and
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05 of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me bySection 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended byActs Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968) hereby appointMr. S. G. Sooriyaarachchi, No. 22/1, Sri Pemararthna Mawatha, Menikdiwela to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo,25th June, 2018.
